title: Muscle Loss Jumps From 4% To 18% Per Decade
hook: Muscle loss jumps from 4% to 18% per decade.
closing: Strength training matters because later muscle loss accelerates instead of staying steady.
question: How often do you strength train?

segments.say: Muscle mass can fall to 65 percent of its starting level, making everyday strength harder to preserve.
Muscle loss rises to 18 percent per decade later in life, so delaying strength work becomes more costly.
Resistance training drove measured sarcopenia to zero in the study, showing muscle decline is not automatically irreversible.
